targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(operation_event_count), 0) AS value FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel';

SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(success_count) / NULLIF(SUM(operation_event_count), 0), 0) AS value FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel';

SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(failed_count) / NULLIF(SUM(operation_event_count), 0), 0) AS value FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(non_terminal_count), 0) AS value FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pending_age_gte_60m_count), 0) AS value FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel';

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(freshness_lag_seconds), 0) AS value FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel';

SELECT window_start AS time, CONCAT(provider, ' / ', region) AS metric, SUM(operation_event_count) AS value FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY window_start, provider, region ORDER BY window_start;

SELECT window_start AS time, 100.0 * SUM(success_count) / NULLIF(SUM(operation_event_count), 0) AS "Success rate", 100.0 * SUM(failed_count) / NULLIF(SUM(operation_event_count), 0) AS "Failure rate" FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start;

SELECT window_start AS time, SUM(success_count) AS success, SUM(failed_count) AS failed, SUM(pending_count) AS pending, SUM(unknown_count) AS unknown FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start;

SELECT window_start AS time, SUM(pending_age_lt_5m_count) AS "< 5m", SUM(pending_age_5_to_15m_count) AS "5-15m", SUM(pending_age_15_to_60m_count) AS "15-60m", SUM(pending_age_gte_60m_count) AS ">= 60m" FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start;

SELECT provider, region, COALESCE(NULLIF(tenant_scope, ''), '-') AS tenant, txn_type, COALESCE(NULLIF(channel_raw, ''), 'unknown') AS channel, SUM(operation_event_count) AS sample_size, SUM(failed_count) AS failed, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(failed_count) / NULLIF(SUM(operation_event_count), 0), 2) AS failure_rate FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY provider, region, tenant_scope, txn_type, channel_raw HAVING SUM(operation_event_count) > 0 ORDER BY failure_rate DESC, sample_size DESC;

SELECT provider, region, COALESCE(NULLIF(tenant_scope, ''), '-') AS tenant, txn_type, COALESCE(NULLIF(channel_raw, ''), 'unknown') AS channel, SUM(non_terminal_count) AS non_terminal, SUM(pending_age_15_to_60m_count) AS pending_15_to_60m, SUM(pending_age_gte_60m_count) AS pending_over_60m, MAX(oldest_pending_age_seconds) AS oldest_pending_seconds FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY provider, region, tenant_scope, txn_type, channel_raw HAVING SUM(non_terminal_count) > 0 ORDER BY pending_over_60m DESC, oldest_pending_seconds DESC;

SELECT window_start AS time, CONCAT(provider, ' / ', region) AS metric, 100.0 * SUM(late_event_count) / NULLIF(SUM(total_count), 0) AS value FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY window_start, provider, region ORDER BY window_start;

SELECT window_start AS time, SUM(parse_error_count) AS "Parse errors", SUM(invalid_amount_count) AS "Invalid amount", SUM(missing_currency_count) AS "Missing currency" FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start;

list.name: region
list.label: Region
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT region FROM window_aggregate ORDER BY region

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tenant_scope FROM window_aggregate WHERE region LIKE '$region' ORDER BY tenant_scope

list.name: provider
list.label: Provider
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT provider FROM window_aggregate WHERE region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' ORDER BY provider

list.name: txn_type
list.label: Transaction type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT txn_type FROM window_aggregate WHERE region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' ORDER BY txn_type

list.name: channel
list.label: Channel
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT channel_raw FROM window_aggregate WHERE region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' ORDER BY channel_raw
